title: Appu
desc: Taxi driver Appu is haunted by his past when his sister gets killed by a eunuch who was also a powerful pimp. While trying to find him, he comes across another girl who is about to meet the same fate.

title: Mouna Geethangal
desc: A woman realises she is pregnant after she divorces her husband for having an affair. Many years later, her husband enters her life, eager to reunite with her.

title: Subramaniapuram
desc: A group of friends known for being notorious find support in an aspiring politician. However, when they kill a man at his behest, he abandons them to fend for themselves.

title: Raajiyam
desc: Karthikeyan runs a secret agency. When he proves that the governor's son has killed his own wife, the leader hatches a plan to exact revenge.
